standard_prerequisites.name: Univalent type theory and supplied HIIT elimination
standard_prerequisites.statement: Dependent sums and products; mere propositions and their truncation elimination; function extensionality and univalence for propositions; the supplied higher inductive-inductive surreal constructors and mutual elimination rules. A reflexive mere relation implying identity makes its type a set.

core_obligations: Choose the outer predicate-pair codomain with right transitivity and equip it with two orders so that preserving these orders expresses all required left transitivity laws.
Use a genuinely dependent inner induction, carrying left-option and right-option compatibility, to define the two code relations while simultaneously establishing strict-to-nonstrict implication.

Verify constructor preservation using the interacting inner and outer hypotheses, closing right transitivity and then the symmetric left-transitivity cases without assuming order transitivity in advance.
difficulty_reason: After the standard HIIT eliminators and proposition extensionality are allowed, the nonroutine content is choosing and coupling two strengthened induction motives. A simple recursion on cuts is insufficient: the inner dependent motive must carry compatibility with both families of outer options. This is an independent order-code construction, not the subsequent formal encode-decode or transitivity corollary.

Cauchy metric approximation uses rounded epsilon relations and separated predicate recursion; this surreal target needs two orders, six bimodule laws and a dependent inner induction. No metric target or downstream order corollary is counted here.
The in-flight book claims concern factorization, suspension and pushout path connectivity, not surreal order-code construction.
Existing HoTT-related hypercubical-manifold item q-pres is a different source and cubical presentation claim.
